title: Netherite Plated Elytra
description: Adds a new Netherite Plated Elytra!
body:
## Features
### New Items
**Netherite Plated Elytra**
- Won't burn in Lava or Fire
- Provides +4 Armor
- Double Durability (864)
### New Recipes
**Netherite Plated Elytra Smithing Recipe**
- Netherite Upgrade Smithing Tamplate
- Elytra
- Netherite Ingot
### New Advancements
**Heavy Metal Wings**
- Obtain the Netherite Plated Elytra
## Compatibility
- [Elytra Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-trims) by [KikuGie](https://modrinth.com/user/KikuGie)
- [Elytra Physics](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-physics) by [OhHeyItsJosh](https://modrinth.com/user/OhHeyItsJosh)
## FAQ
> **Q: Will you add support for other Minecraft versions and modloaders?**
> 
> A: If there's enough demand in my Discord, I'll port the mod to other versions and modloaders.

[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/pw8BsjsXfK)
